paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the average performance of models on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks in terms of their parameter count, with the x-axis representing model size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70m to 7.0B, and marked at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis represents average performance as a percentage, on a linear scale, from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Three lines are shown: a red line with triangle markers representing precision, which starts at approximately 79% for a model size of 70m and remains relatively stable, ending at around 72% for a model size of 7.0B, with a slight decrease; a blue line with triangle markers representing recall, which increases steadily from around 15% at 70m to approximately 48% at 7.0B; and a purple line with triangle markers representing F1-score, which also increases steadily from around 17% at 70m to around 60% at 7.0B.
